jobs.title: Regional Coach
jobs.description: REGIONAL COACH Gastronomy Restaurants Ltd | KFC franchise partner Field-based with regular travel across your assigned regional patch We’re looking for an experienced regional operations leader to lead 3 to 4 Area Coaches across approximately 25 restaurants . You’ll bring experience managing Area Managers or equivalent multi-site leaders and delivering strong people, operational and commercial results. Gastronomy’s restaurants are across the Midlands, North West and North Wales . You’ll cover an assigned patch within this area, travelling regularly between restaurants. We’re flexible about where you live, provided you can be present across your patch to support your Area Coaches and their teams. Welcome to KFC. Home of the real ones. We sell the world’s best chicken. We’ve done it for a long old time, since 1939, when the idea of finger lickin’ good chicken popped into our Colonel’s head. Now, we proudly serve 1000+ communities across the UK and Ireland, bringing the grit, pride and iconic reputation that started in Kentucky all those years ago. People who are original. Individual. Fresh. We come to work to be ourselves, and to make something of ourselves. We bring the graft and the laughs every day, building our own community, as we serve our original recipe chicken to the ones we’re in. In our place, ambition grows. Careers build. Potential goes further. Our doors are open, and they can take you anywhere. If you join our team, we only ask one thing. That you be you. Because that makes us, us. Sound good? Great. Here’s more about the job. About the role Reporting to the Director of Operations, you’ll take ownership of your region’s People, Guest, Sales and Profit performance. You’ll develop your Area Coaches, set clear priorities and hold them accountable for building successful restaurant teams and delivering consistent standards. You’ll combine strategic planning with regular time in restaurants, using what you see and hear to improve performance, strengthen leadership and support the business’s long-term growth. What will you spend your time doing? Lead and develop your Area Coaches: Set clear objectives, coach and challenge performance, and support development through regular reviews and visits across the region. Shape and deliver the strategy: Contribute to the business’s operational strategy and translate it into practical regional plans. Use performance data, local insights and market trends to identify priorities and opportunities. Own commercial performance: Take responsibility for your region’s profit and loss, grow sales and manage costs. Agree improvement plans with your Area Coaches and follow through on delivery while protecting quality and service. Build your leadership pipeline: Plan succession and future staffing needs over a 12 to 24 month horizon. Work with the People and Recruitment teams to attract, develop and retain leaders who can support our growth. Deliver consistent standards: Drive food quality, guest experience and operational efficiency. Use feedback, audits and business data to identify issues, agree actions and make improvements that last. Lead change and improvement: Lead the rollout of new technology, processes and operational initiatives. Help your teams adapt, simplify how restaurants work and share improvements across the business. Lead on safety and incident response: Champion health and safety, food safety and compliance. Act as the first escalation point for serious operational incidents, lead the response in line with established procedures and ensure critical risks are escalated and addressed promptly. Work across the business: Partner with People, Finance and central support teams. Keep communication clear between restaurant teams, Area Coaches and the Director of Operations, providing timely updates on performance, risks and opportunities. What we love from you: Experience at this level: You bring a strong record in regional operations, with experience leading Area Managers, Area Coaches or equivalent multi-site leaders in hospitality, retail or a comparable operational environment. Commercial understanding: You’re confident owning financial performance, managing budgets and using data to make sound decisions that improve sales and profit. The ability to develop leaders: You know how to coach experienced managers, spot potential and address underperformance with clear expectations and practical support. Strategic thinking and delivery: You can plan ahead while staying close to what’s happening in restaurants and helping your teams turn priorities into action. Calm, accountable leadership: You make considered decisions under pressure, lead teams through change and take ownership when challenges arise. Our values in action: You demonstrate Courage, Culture and Growth through the way you lead, develop people and work with others. Keeping it real We don’t hire staff. We hire people. People with real lives and aspirations, building real careers. Each of us has something special to add to the mix we call work, and we’ll always encourage you to add your perspective. See, at KFC, everyone’s welcome, whatever your background, and whatever future you’re creating. We’ll look out for you because you’re one of us, not because you work for us. We’ll invest in your potential, because it’s what we’ve always done. But most of all, we’ll give you the freedom to be you, wherever (and whoever) you happen to be. What’s in it for you: We offer a bonus opportunity alongside the chance to lead a region within a growing KFC franchise business. KFC for everyone: Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, KFC is a place where you can bring the real you to work. We’re here to support you in being yourself, whether you work with us, or are trying to. Our promise is this: every person who applies to a role at KFC, regardless of age, background, ethnicity, gender, ability, religion or sexual orientation, will have an equal opportunity to work here. We don’t just welcome, we encourage applications from underrepresented groups in all industries. If you’d like any additional support with your application, have a disability or condition that may affect your performance during the recruitment process, or have any other requirements, just let us know. We’ll be there to help you be the real you. Ready? We hope so. If you’re ready to be part of our community, now’s the time to apply. Worried you aren’t ticking all the boxes? Don’t. We’d still love to hear from you. This role is with Gastronomy Restaurants Ltd, a KFC franchise partner. Benefits and employment terms may differ from those offered by KFC-owned restaurants or other franchise partners.

jobs.title: Head of Innovation
jobs.description: Welcome to KFC. Home of the real ones. We sell the world’s best chicken. Seriously. And we’ve done it since 1939, when the idea of crispy, original recipe chicken took Kentucky by storm. Now, we’re proud to serve 1000+ communities across the UK and Ireland, bringing the grit, pride and iconic reputation that we started with, all those years ago. Across the Restaurant Support Centre (RSC), we come to work to be ourselves, and to make something of ourselves. We want to see our potential go that little bit further, as part of one of the world’s most iconic brands. What’s the gig? Well, you support our restaurants — and we’ll support you every step of the way. Simple. Our doors are open — and they can take you anywhere. All we ask is that you be you. Because that makes us, us. Sound good? Great. Let’s find out about that job. THE TEAM Our Marketing team is a 50-strong crew of bold thinkers, culture shapers and creative doers - from Brand and Digital to Strategy, Corporate Affairs, Food Quality and Innovation. We’re here to keep KFC at the heart of culture across the UK & Ireland, blending our iconic roots with fresh, fearless ideas that connect with real people. We don’t just make ads - we build love, drive growth, and stay one step ahead of what’s next. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a senior growth role at the heart of KFC UK&I’s future menu and customer strategy. You’ll lead our three-year Menu Vision, shape the occasions and need states we want to win, and own the Innovation portfolio that brings those opportunities to life. From new growth platforms and value innovation to partnerships and future menu ideas, you’ll help decide where we place our bets and what we prioritise. You’ll connect customer insight, commercial opportunity and restaurant reality, bringing teams across Food, Brand, Commercial, Digital, Operations and Supply Chain together behind a clear growth agenda. And because UK&I is a lead market for KFC globally, your influence won’t stop here. You’ll also help shape Global thinking, investment and future innovation priorities. WHAT YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME DOING Menu Vision, CUO & Value Growth Strategy - Own our three-year Menu Vision and define the customer occasions and need states we want to win. - You’ll turn customer and cultural insight into clear growth priorities, setting the guardrails for Food, Brand, Commercial, Digital and Operations and translating them into AOP commitments and an 18–36 month roadmap. - You’ll also shape how Innovation contributes to our Value agenda, making sure we’re creating compelling propositions for customers while delivering sustainable commercial growth. Innovation Portfolio & Growth Platform - Own and prioritise the Innovation portfolio across core menu optimisation, value innovation, scalable platforms, calendar innovation, collaborations and longer-term pipeline - You’ll make clear choices around what we start, stop, accelerate or deprioritise, balancing customer opportunity, commercial return, restaurant complexity and available resource. - For the biggest opportunities, you’ll build the case and recommend where KFC should place its next major bets. Growth System, Briefs & Decision Making - Create a clear and effective innovation system that takes ideas from insight through to test, learn and scale. - You’ll set stage gates, lead decision forums and make go/no-go calls within agreed guardrails. - Most importantly, you’ll turn strategy into brilliant briefs and clear propositions that give teams the confidence and clarity to deliver. Commercial Accountability & Enterprise Mobilisation - Great ideas only matter if they drive growth. - You’ll partner closely with Commercial and Finance to size opportunities, define success measures and build compelling business cases. - You’ll use insight and commercial judgement to make clear recommendations, challenge thinking where needed and bring our Leadership Team, franchisees and cross-functional teams behind the strongest opportunities. Global Lead Market & Strategic Partnerships - UK&I plays an important role in shaping the future of KFC globally. - You’ll represent UK&I as a lead market across Menu Vision, Snacking and CUO growth, selected partnerships and future innovation. - You’ll build strong relationships with Global teams, influence multi-market priorities and make sure we’re using the best thinking and investment from across the KFC system. People Leadership & Senior Leadership Deputy - You’ll lead and coach our Innovation team, creating clarity, accountability and space for people to grow. - You’ll also independently lead major Customer Strategy and Menu Growth agendas and deputise for the Strategy & Innovation Director with senior leaders, franchisees and Global teams. WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH Pretty much everyone. - You’ll work closely with our Strategy & Innovation Director and wider leadership team, as well as teams across Insights & CX, Food, Brand, Commercial, Finance, Digital, Operations and Supply Chain. - You’ll also build strong relationships with franchisees, Global Menu and Innovation teams, and external partners and collaborators. - This role isn’t about owning every piece of delivery yourself. It’s about creating clarity, making strong decisions and bringing brilliant people together behind the right opportunities. WHAT WE’D LOVE FROM YOU - You’ll likely bring around 10+ years’ experience across innovation, food, menu, brand or customer growth within a fast-moving consumer business. - Experience in QSR, FMCG, retail, hospitality or another consumer-led brand would be brilliant. We’d love to see: - Experience owning a multi-year innovation, customer growth or portfolio strategy, not just delivering individual projects. - Strong understanding of customer behaviour, occasions and need states, and how to turn them into propositions people genuinely want. - Commercial confidence, with experience sizing opportunities, developing business cases and making investment and resource trade-offs. - Experience leading innovation systems, including stage gates, test-and-learnand scaling successful platforms. - Strong cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on hierarchy. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: We offer benefits that make your life that little bit easier, because we know the juggle is real. From flexible, hybrid working to Fri-Yay early finishes and Live Well Days, we’ve created a package that supports the real you, in and out of work. You’ll get: Hybrid working from our Woking RSC (just 24 mins from London). This role is remote based but occasional visits to our RSC will be required. Up to 11% company pension contributions Fri-Yay finishes at 1pm every Friday 25 days’ holiday (plus bank hols) a 5 Live Well Days a year, just for you Bonus scheme linked to company & personal performance Private healthcare, Digital GP access & mental health coaching Enhanced parental leave and flexible return options Study support, income protection, life cover & more And yes - 25% off the chicken Because real ones deserve real rewards. KFC FOR EVERYONE: Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, KFC is a place where you can bring the real you to work. Our promise is this: every person who applies to a role at KFC, regardless of age, background, ethnicity, gender, ability, religion or sexual orientation, will have an equal opportunity to work here. We don’t just welcome, we encourage applications from underrepresented groups from all industries. If you’d like any additional support with your application, have a disability or condition that may affect your performance during the recruitment process, or have any other requirements — just let us know. We’ll be there to help you be the real you. Ready? We hope so, if you’re ready to be part of our community, now’s the time to apply. Worried you aren’t ticking all the boxes? Don’t - we’d still love to hear from you. Beware of fake job postings using Yum! and/or our brand logos -- KFC, Pizza Hut, Taco Bell and Habit Burger & Grill -- on fraudulent sites. Yum! Brands only posts jobs on official careers pages and never asks for money during onboarding. Avoid unsolicited contacts via Telegram, WhatsApp or similar social apps.

jobs.title: Reporting Finance Manager
jobs.location: Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, MK6 4BB, United Kingdom
jobs.description:
About The Role
You Bring The Flavour. Together, We Deliver Delicious.
At Domino's, great decisions start with great insight.
As our Reporting Finance Manager, you'll help shape how the business understands performance, providing the reporting, forecasting and analytical insight that enables leaders to make informed commercial decisions. You'll own the development of high-quality reporting and dashboard solutions that bring together financial and operational performance, transforming complex data into clear, actionable stories.
This is a unique opportunity to lead the evolution of our reporting capability. Working at the intersection of Finance, Commercial and Business Intelligence teams, you'll help move the business from traditional spreadsheet-based reporting towards intuitive, insight-led dashboards that empower stakeholders to self-serve information and focus on driving performance.
If you're passionate about financial reporting, data visualisation and using technology to improve decision-making, we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Bring
We're looking for a commercially minded finance professional who combines strong reporting expertise with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive meaningful change.
You'll ideally bring:
 A recognised accountancy qualification such as ACCA, CIMA or ACA, alongside relevant post-qualified experience within Reporting, Commercial Finance or FP&A.
 Strong experience in financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting and performance analysis within a finance function.
 Advanced Excel skills and experience managing, interpreting and analysing large, complex datasets.
 Strong Power BI capability, including building interactive dashboards from the ground up and creating self-service reporting solutions for business stakeholders.
 Experience writing SQL queries to extract, manipulate and analyse data from large datasets and data warehouses.
 Experience designing intuitive dashboards and data visualisations that focus on insight, usability and decision-making rather than static reporting.
 The ability to convert complex data into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders.
 Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting performance insights and commercial recommendations to senior leadership teams.
 Experience partnering with commercial functions such as Sales, Marketing or Revenue teams to translate data into meaningful business actions.
 Previous people management or coaching experience, with a passion for developing and upskilling others.
 A strong understanding of commercial performance drivers including sales, trade, budgeting and forecasting.
 An interest in emerging technologies, AI capabilities and modern reporting solutions that can enhance reporting effectiveness and business insight.
 The ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, manage competing priorities and drive continuous improvement.
What You'll Be Doing
As our Reporting Finance Manager, you'll:
 Lead the delivery of weekly, period-end and trading performance reporting across the business.
 Own the sales budgeting and forecasting process, partnering with key stakeholders to ensure forecasts are accurate, robust and commercially relevant.
 Produce insightful performance packs covering sales, trade, traffic, commercial KPIs and key marketing initiatives.
 Develop and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards that provide greater visibility of business performance and enable self-service reporting.
 Utilise SQL and other analytical tools to extract, interrogate and analyse data to support business reporting and insight generation.
 Lead the transition from spreadsheet-led reporting to intuitive, dashboard-driven performance management.
 Design reporting solutions that allow stakeholders to drill into performance, understand trends and answer key business questions independently.
 Conduct campaign, promotional and trade-driving activity analysis, evaluating performance, return on investment and commercial impact.
 Support interim and full-year reporting requirements through high-quality analysis and commentary.
 Identify trends, opportunities and risks, providing recommendations that support business performance and strategic objectives.
 Act as the central point of contact for sales reporting and performance-related queries across the business.
 Lead, coach and develop a Reporting Finance Analyst, supporting their progression from traditional Excel reporting towards modern dashboard and BI reporting capabilities.
 Work closely with Finance, Marketing, Revenue Management, Business Intelligence and Investor Relations teams to deliver reporting that drives action and commercial value.
 Champion continuous improvement, automation and innovation across reporting processes, leveraging technology and data visualisation to improve efficiency and insight quality.
 Explore opportunities to leverage emerging AI and business intelligence capabilities to improve reporting efficiency and business insight.
How We Will Support You
At Domino's, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of financial reporting within a business that values insight, innovation and continuous improvement.
In return, you'll benefit from:
 Exposure to senior leadership and strategic decision-making.
 The opportunity to lead transformative reporting and dashboard initiatives.
 A collaborative environment where Finance, Commercial and BI teams work closely together.
 The chance to influence how performance is measured and understood across the organisation.
 Opportunities to develop your leadership, commercial and technical expertise.
 A hybrid working environment that supports flexibility and balance.
 Competitive salary and benefits.

Senior Employee Relations Manager
People Team
At Domino's, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We're looking for an experienced Senior Employee Relations Manager to lead our Employee and Industrial Relations strategy across the UK & Ireland, helping us navigate an evolving employment landscape while building a positive and engaging workplace environment. 
 This is a key leadership role within our People team, responsible for shaping our Employee and Industrial Relations agendas, partnering senior stakeholders, and ensuring our managers are equipped to lead their teams confidently and consistently. 
What You'll Be Doing
  Lead and implement Domino's Employee Relations and Industrial Relations strategy across the UK & Ireland.
 Build strong relationships with Trade Unions, driving positive and proactive partnerships.
 Provide expert guidance on complex employee relations matters, including tribunal and litigation cases.
 Drive our engagement strategy and agenda, including continued development of our Employee Forums and colleague surveys.
 Develop engaging policies, processes and toolkits that support business objectives and ensure legal compliance.
 Partner with leaders across the business to build capability and improve manager confidence in handling employee relations matters.

 Significant experience in Employee Relations within a complex, multi-site organisation.
 Strong employment law expertise and hands-on experience managing complex ER cases.
 Proven experience working with Trade Unions and industrial relations frameworks.
 Commercial awareness with the ability to balance people, risk and business outcomes.
 The ability to influence and build credibility with stakeholders at all levels.
 Strong leadership experience with a track record of developing high-performing teams.
 Excellent communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
 CIPD qualified or educated to degree level in HR, Business or a related discipline.

jobs.title: Platter Team Leader
jobs.description:
We are incredibly proud to be growing our partnership with John Lewis to deliver a new brand for their in-store restaurants in 32 of the retailer's stores. This is an incredibly exciting time to reimagine the offering with fresh, quality ingredients which are thoughtfully sourced and rooted in local suppliers. 
Are you a visionary hospitality leader ready to shape an iconic partnership at the highest level? We are seeking an exceptional Team Leader to offer the highest standard of service, providing a positive and efficient customer experience by preparing and serving quality food and beverages, whilst ensuring the smooth running of the location.

We are seeking an enthusiastic and organized Platter Team Leader to join our dynamic hospitality team in Norwich, United Kingdom. In this leadership role, you will oversee the platter service area, leading a dedicated team while maintaining our commitment to exceptional customer experiences and operational excellence. You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with all food safety and health regulations while fostering a collaborative and supportive team environment. This is an ideal opportunity for a motivated professional ready to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced food service setting.
Lead, supervise, and mentor platter team members, providing clear direction and constructive feedback to support their professional development
Maintain the highest standards of customer experience across all service interactions and ensure consistent quality in food presentation and service delivery
Ensure strict adherence to food safety compliance, health and safety regulations, and COSHH guidelines at all times
Organize and oversee delivery operations, including checking delivery notes, verifying inventory accuracy, and reporting any discrepancies promptly
Conduct daily team briefings, communicate key information, and address team queries with transparency and empathy
Manage cash handling procedures, operate tills accurately, take customer orders, and serve food and beverages with professionalism
Take ownership of specific food offerings or service areas, with flexibility to rotate and support other sections as needed
Assist with table clearing and general service duties while modeling a strong work ethic and collaborative spirit
Monitor team performance, identify training needs, and implement solutions to enhance efficiency and service quality
Support the management team with operational decisions and contribute to achieving business goals and targets

Proven leadership and team management experience in a hospitality or food service environment
Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate expectations clearly and listen actively to team members
Excellent organizational and time management abilities, with the capacity to prioritize multiple tasks effectively
Demonstrated ability to work under pressure while maintaining composure and delivering quality results
Reliable, self-motivated, and proactive approach to work with a positive can-do attitude
Strong teamwork and collaborative skills with the ability to build inclusive and supportive team dynamics
Proven conflict resolution and problem-solving capabilities
Experience with cash handling, till operations, and point-of-sale systems
Knowledge of food safety regulations, health and safety standards, and legislative compliance requirements
Mentoring and coaching experience with a commitment to supporting team development and performance improvement

As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. The Support Engineering group is at the heart of this mission. We build high-performance admin applications and core operational tools that empower our support teams to work smarter and faster. A key part of this is our in-house chat platform, which already handles around 5 million conversations every month. On top of this foundation, we’re developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them. Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we’re ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale. About the role We’re now looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You’ll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day. What you’ll be doing Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go . Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe. Design systems that are scalable , resilient , and easy to maintain. Lead and contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making. Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards. Requirements 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems. 2+ years of production experience in Golang , with the ability to mentor others and drive best practices across the team. Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra. Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems .
